item.title: Over €800k Funding Announced For Clare Renovation Projects
item.description: Over €800,000 in funding has been made available to renovate key buildings across Clare. Mountshannon is the biggest beneficiary where €500,000 has been allocated under the Town and Village Renewal Scheme to refurbish a 1940’s community hall into a modern accessible theatre with a market space. item.title: €760K Worth Of Herbal Cannabis Seized At Shannon Airport
item.description: €760,000 worth of illegal drugs have been seized at Shannon Airport. Assisted by Detector Dog Brody, Revenue Customs Officer discovered 38kg of herbal cannabis this afternoon. The drugs were discovered in shipments originating from the USA and were destined for addresses in the South and Mid-West. Investigations are ongoing.
